{{Disambig|Elf}}

==Towers==
'''Elf''' may refer to these towers:
*[[Elf Camp]], an offensive spawner tower that spawns a variety of units
**[[Elf Camp/Gallery]]
**[[Elf Camp/History]]

==Enemies==
'''Elf''' may refer to these enemies:
*[[Trickster Elf]], an enemy that can buff other enemies, that first appears on Wave 29 in [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode
It can also refer to these event enemies:
*[[Basic Elf (Cold Ambush)]], the first enemy that appeared in [[Cold Ambush]]
*[[Basic Elf (Krampus Frosthold)]], an enemy that first appears on Wave 1 on [[Krampus Frosthold]]
*[[Bomber Elf (Cold Ambush)]], an enemy that exploded and stunned towers upon death that first appeared on Wave 16 in [[Cold Ambush]]
*[[Bomber Elf (Krampus Frosthold)]], an enemy that explodes and stuns towers upon death by setting them on fire that first appears on Wave 7 in [[Krampus Frosthold]]
*[[Builder Elf (Cold Ambush)]], a summoner enemy that spawned [[Toy Soldier (Cold Ambush)|Toy Soldier]]s that first appeared on Wave 19 in [[Cold Ambush]]
*[[Builder Elf (Krampus Frosthold)]], a summoner enemy that spawns [[Toy Soldier (Krampus Frosthold)|Toy Soldier]]s that first appears on Wave 18 in [[Krampus Frosthold]]
*[[Evil Elf (Cold Ambush)]], a strong enemy that could stun towers that first appeared on Wave 18 in [[Cold Ambush]]
*[[Evil Elf (Krampus Frosthold)]], a strong enemy that can stun towers that first appears on Wave 20 in [[Krampus Frosthold]]
*[[Ripped Elf (Cold Ambush)]], a strong boss enemy that could stun towers and damage the base that first appeared on Wave 12 in [[Cold Ambush]]
*[[Ripped Elf (Krampus Frosthold)]], the boss for the first stage of [[Krampus Frosthold]] that can stun towers
*[[Speedy Elf (Cold Ambush)]], a fast enemy that first appeared on Wave 3 in [[Cold Ambush]]
*[[Speedy Elf (Krampus Frosthold)]], a fast enemy that first appears on Wave 2 in [[Krampus Frosthold]]
**[[Speedy Elf (Krampus Frosthold)/Advanced Stats]]

==Units==
'''Elf''' may refer to these units:
*[[Bomber Elf (Unit)]], a destruction explosion-based unit spawned by the Level 2-3 [[Elf Camp]]
**[[Bomber Elf (Unit)/Gallery]]
*[[Cannoneer Elf]], a ranged unit that fires snowballs spawned by the Level 2 [[Elf Camp]]
**[[Cannoneer Elf/Gallery]]
*[[Elf]], a collision-based unit spawned by the Level 0-2 [[Elf Camp]]
**[[Elf/Gallery]]
*[[Guardian Elf]], a melee-based unit spawned by the Level 3+ [[Elf Camp]]
**[[Guardian Elf/Gallery]]
*[[Gunner Elf]], a ranged unit that shoots snowballs in bursts spawned by the Level 3+ [[Elf Camp]]
**[[Gunner Elf/Gallery]]
*[[Ripped Elf (Unit)]], a ranged unit that throws snowballs with splash damage spawned by the Level 4 [[Elf Camp]]
**[[Ripped Elf (Unit)/Gallery]]
*[[Snowball Elf]], a ranged unit that throws snowballs spawned by the Level 1 [[Elf Camp]]
**[[Snowball Elf/Gallery]]
